Buying in Milton? Check these 4 things besides price: 1) your real commute, tested at rush hour, 2) ongoing costs like property tax, insurance and utilities, 3) which school boards serve the address, 4) planned development nearby (check the town website). Save this for your Milton home search.

3 questions to ask before your mortgage pre-approval: 1) How long is my rate held, and what happens if rates change before I buy? 2) What are the prepayment rules, and what could it cost to break the mortgage early? 3) What can change my approval? A job change, new debt or the property itself can matter. Save this for your lender conversation.

A buyer asked me: do I need a lawyer? Yes: a real estate lawyer handles your closing. They check title and register the transfer. Ask a lawyer to review the agreement before you sign. Get a fee quote early so closing costs are no surprise. Send this to someone buying in Mississauga.
